text: At its meeting of June 4, 2018, the Finance, Audit and Risk Management Committee considered the report (May 18, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto on 2017 Audited Financial Results.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the 2017 Audited Financial Results as noted in Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (May 18, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Received Confidential Attachment 4 to the report (May 18, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto for information. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the report (May 18, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential as they pertain to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
